faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before setting up your wedding.

one.question: Do my guests need to install an app?
one.answer: No. Guests just open the link you share — on any phone, tablet, or computer, with no download or account required.

two.question: Can I change the seating after I've shared the link?
two.answer: Yes. Any change you make to tables or guests updates instantly, so guests always see the current seating plan.

three.question: How long is my wedding page available after the event?
three.answer: It depends on your plan — from 30 days up to a full year of storage after the wedding, so you can keep collecting and downloading photos.

four.question: Can I use my own colors and names?
four.answer: Yes. Every wedding gets its own theme color, couple names, and a public URL, so the page matches your wedding's style.
